sameDatabaseAsBackendProof.question: Is the diagnostic query hitting the same DB as the backend? (backend -> DB A, query -> DB B would invalidate everything)
sameDatabaseAsBackendProof.proof1: The diagnostic used the identical --env-file=.env as the running backend, so it resolves the same DATABASE_URL.
sameDatabaseAsBackendProof.proof2: LIVE COUPLING: the diagnostic observed updatedAt on the 6 eta.* rows advancing in real time (last update 0.1 minutes before the read) and attempts incrementing +36 over a 30s window. Those writes are produced ONLY by the backend's outbox processor. Observing the backend's own writes as they happen proves a shared database.
sameDatabaseAsBackendProof.proof3: The fresh event emitted by the diagnostic was picked up and PUBLISHED by the backend's processor within 5s — a write by the diagnostic was read and acted on by the backend.
